ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENT ANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT MADEBY FIFTHAVENUERETAILPROPERTIESLLC and 562FIFTHLLC Dated: as ofNovember 21,2013 BLOCK:1262 LOT34 RECORD AND RETURN TO: KRAMERLEVINNAFTALISANDFRANKELLLP 1177AVENUEOFTHEAMERICAS NEWYORK,NEWYORK10036 ATTENTION: PAUL D.SELVER,ESQ. USIBERNSZAI9200396.4

THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT ANDEASEMENT AGREEMENT ("Agreement") made as of the 21st day of November, 2013 by and between FIFTH AVENUE RETAIL PROPERTIES LLC, a Delaware limited liability company,with offices at c/o SL Green Realty Corp., 420 Lexington Avenue, New York, New York 10170 ("Owner"), and 562 FIFTH LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, with offices at c/o Extell Development Company, 805 Third Avenue, 7"h Floor, New York, New York 10022 ("Developer"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Owner is the owner of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the City of New York, Borough of Manhattan,which land and improvements lie below horizontal plane (the “Cantilever Lower Limiting Plane") drawn at a an elevation of two hundred thirty (230) feet above Datum Level (as hereinafter defined), with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the City of New York, Borough of Manhattan, generally known by street address 574 Fifth Avenue, NewYork, NewYork,currently designated as part of Tax Lot 39 in Block 1262 on the Tax Map and more particularly described on Exhibit A annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land being herein called the “Owner Land,”" said buildings Existing Owner Building and the Owner Building (as hereinafter defined) being herein collectively called the “Owner Premises"), excluding the Subject Floor Area Development Rights(ashereinafterdefined); WHEREAS, Developer is the owner of that certain parcel of air space (the "Airspace Premises"), which lies above the Cantilever Lower Limiting Plane, currently designated as part of Tax Lot 39 in Block 1262 on the Tax Map, as more particularly described on Exhibit B annexed hereto and made a part hereof, together with the Subject Floor Area Development Rights; WHEREAS, by execution of a Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions of even Owner Land and the Airspace Premises continue to be a single and separate zoning lot, which zoning lot may be enlarged in accordance with the terms of this Agreement (as the same may be enlarged, the “Combined Zoning Lot"), for the purpose of making available the Subject Floor Area Development Rights (as hereinafter defined) for utilization in connection with the construction of one or more New Developer Buildings (as hereinafter defined); WHEREAS, the parties have caused all parties in interest (as defined in the Zoning Resolution) to the Combined Zoning Lot other than the Owner and Developer, as shown on the Zoning Lot Certification of Chicago Title Insurance Company ("Certification"), annexed hereto as Exhibit D,to confirm the existence of the Combined ZoningLot,to waive their right to execute any Declarations relating to any future expansion of the Combined Zoning Lot, and to subordinate their respective interest to this Agreement, as amended, by execution of a Waiver of Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions and Subordination to Zoning Lot Development Agreement;
